dex.entry: A palm-sized moth draped in velvet-grey wings that shed fine null-dust — a powder that drains faint light sources on contact. Its dead lantern marking on each hindwing is unmistakable. The snuffed-lantern wing pattern is the emblem of the Coldfog Marches — instantly iconic.

art.silhouette: Slate-grey wings with a stylised snuffed-lantern motif on each hindwing — the lantern arch and pane visible but the flame glyph hollow; body wrapped in soft ashen fuzz; dull violet undersides.
